entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mind mage who shields the Gatewatch's minds inside a spell shaped like his Ravnica sanctum and then helps bind Emrakul.

entities.name: Contingency Jace
entities.description: A copy of Jace that lives in the mental tower and holds a contingency plan Jace made on arriving on Innistrad; it merges back into Jace.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who holds Emrakul back with the Chain Veil and her zombies, nearly dies, and then swears the Gatewatch oath for her own ends.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and soldier of the Gatewatch; Jace sees a vision of him questioned by Erebos.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A fire-wielding planeswalker of the Gatewatch; Jace sees a vision of her as a child burning her persecutors.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker of the Gatewatch who is mentally taken over by Emrakul's influence and later heals Liliana and powers the binding spell.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk planeswalker and scholar and mind-linked friend of Jace who has a binding spell and is possessed to read a second scroll.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The third Eldrazi titan, a vast purple cloud with countless tendrils that assaults minds; she is bound in Innistrad's moon.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A tall hooded angel with two swords and writhing ribbons whom Jace knows from statues on Zendikar; in his mind she plays chess with him and speaks for Emrakul, though he concludes it is only his mind personifying Emrakul.

entities.name: Raven Man
entities.description: A voice in Liliana's head that begs her to flee Emrakul and calls her death the best possible outcome.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact Liliana wields whose power splits her skin and which whispers 'vessel of destruction, root of evil' and urges her to flee Emrakul.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: A towering celestial being made of a starry night sky, with black horns and a skull-handled whip, who interrogates Gideon in a vision inside Jace's mind.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, whose lifeless jet-black eyes opened in one of her worst memories.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A being whose baleful gaze and poisoned promise of redemption Liliana remembers.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel whose last words to her creator, that what cannot be destroyed must be bound, Jace remembers; he also compares Emeria's height to hers.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A source of knowledge Jace used to attach Tamiyo's spell to Emrakul.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon lord Liliana killed.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon lord Liliana killed.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers united to stop Emrakul; Liliana swears its oath at the end.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The ancient entities of which Emrakul is the third titan.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Emrakul has risen and is bound.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Gatewatch destroyed an Eldrazi titan and where Jace saw statues of Emeria.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Jace's sanctum and apartments, which his mental tower copies, are found.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city on Innistrad where the Gatewatch and Liliana's zombies stand against Emrakul.

entities.name: Jace's mental tower
entities.description: A spell-created tower modeled on Jace's Ravnica sanctum that is actually his mind, shielding his friends from Emrakul's mental assault.

entities.name: Innistrad's moon
entities.description: The silver moon where the Helvault came from; it becomes Emrakul's prison, branded with the glyph.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison that held Innistrad's horrors for hundreds of years, which came from the moon.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that gifted Jace a fancy chessboard.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose guildmage Emeria's voice is compared to.

entities.name: Iron-banded scrolls
entities.description: Scrolls with iron bands that Tamiyo did not want to open; the one she reads, controlled by Emrakul, casts a changed spell that traps Emrakul.

entities.name: Binding of Emrakul
entities.description: The spell, built from Tamiyo's binding scroll, Jace's glyph and Nissa's power, that stretches Emrakul into the moon and seals her there.

events.summary: A moonfolk, Tamiyo, flies into the clearing and silently talks mind to mind with Jace while Liliana watches.
events.quote: A moonfolk flew into the clearing, her eyes wide and breath short.

events.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
events.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

events.summary: In Emrakul's presence Liliana wonders whether seeking not to die was the wrong goal, and recalls Josu, Bolas and the Chain Veil as her worst moments.
events.quote: she wondered if she had been pursuing the wrong goal

events.summary: The Raven Man and the Chain Veil both urge Liliana to flee, frightened of Emrakul.
events.quote: Whatever Emrakul was, the Chain Veil wanted no part of it.

events.summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
events.quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

events.summary: Jace finds himself at the top of a spiral staircase in a copy of his Ravnica sanctum while Emrakul tears the tower apart.
events.quote: He was at the top of a long, grand spiraling staircase

events.summary: A voice in Jace's own voice commands him to go downstairs and he descends into the depths of the tower.
events.quote: He descended into the depths of the tower.

events.summary: Fueled by rage, Liliana draws deeply on the Chain Veil, pushes back against Emrakul and takes back her zombies.
events.quote: She felt her zombies return to her.

events.summary: Liliana refuses to be a vessel, silences the Veil and the Raven Man, and prepares to fight Emrakul.
events.quote: She shut down the voices of the Veil and the Raven Man both, silencing them abruptly.

events.summary: Jace sees in a window Gideon, addressed as Kytheon Iora, questioned by the celestial Erebos, who threatens to kill his friends unless he says what he most desires.
events.quote: It is not an offer, mortal.

events.summary: Jace watches in a window as Emrakul's lattices cover Tamiyo's eyes, mouth and hands, erasing her ability to see, speak and write.
events.quote: She is being erased.

events.summary: Liliana blasts Emrakul back with necromantic energy, believing she is winning.
events.quote: For the first time since blossoming, Emrakul was shrinking

events.summary: Jace sees a vision of child Chandra surrounded by guards who say they killed her parents, and she burns them all.
events.quote: I can make the whole world burn.

events.summary: Jace sees Nissa mutated by Emrakul, ranting that growth is the answer, and she tells him she can do anything she wants.
events.quote: I can do anything I want. Anything at all.

events.summary: Liliana's body begins to fail and Emrakul regrows faster than she can blast it, forcing her onto the defensive.
events.quote: now it was all she could do to stand her ground

events.summary: The Raven Man tells Liliana her death is now the best possible outcome and she becomes afraid.
events.quote: You have doomed us both.

events.summary: Through a door at the stairway's end Jace meets an angel he recognizes as Emeria from Zendikar statues and wonders whether she is Emrakul.
events.quote: I know this angel.

events.summary: Emeria offers Jace a game of chess: if he wins, all stops and she will give him answers.
events.quote: If you win, this all stops. I will give you all the answers you want.

events.summary: Jace realizes the angel is his mind's personification of Emrakul and checkmates her.
events.quote: He put his hand on his queen, moved it into position.

events.summary: Jace's chess pieces mutate and kill each other, and the angel says they were always her pieces and she no longer wants to play.
events.quote: They are all my pieces, Jace Beleren.

events.summary: Liliana's zombies are destroyed by the hundreds as she fights only to survive another moment.
events.quote: Zombies were destroyed by the hundreds under Emrakul's assault

events.summary: Jace meets a copy of himself that makes him answer a riddle to prove he is Jace.
events.quote: No bigger than a pebble but my closing covers the entire world, what am I?

events.summary: Jace realizes he is not in a tower but is the tower, a mind spell he cast reflexively to shield everyone from Emrakul.
events.quote: I'm not in a tower. I am the tower.

events.summary: The copy explains it was a contingency Jace made to stay separate from himself and work out how to stop Emrakul.
events.quote: So I made a contingency plan to keep me separate from me

events.summary: The two Jaces merge; learning Liliana is about to die, Jace dissolves the spell and returns to reality.
events.quote: Jace dissolved the spell.

events.summary: Jace returns to find Liliana unconscious and bleeding, and Emrakul fully unfolded above Thraben.
events.quote: Liliana was on the ground in front of him, unconscious, bleeding profusely from multiple wounds.

events.summary: Jace links the group's minds; Jace and Nissa tell Chandra that burning Emrakul will not work.
events.quote: Trying to burn Emrakul is throwing a torch into the ocean.

events.summary: Tamiyo recalls Avacyn's words and says Emrakul cannot be destroyed and must be bound.
events.quote: We cannot destroy Emrakul. We must bind her.

events.summary: Tamiyo proposes attuning a binding spell to Innistrad's moon and linking it to Emrakul.
events.quote: I have a binding spell. A powerful one. I can attune it to the moon.

events.summary: Nissa agrees to power the spell because Jace freed her mind from Emrakul's darkness.
events.quote: But I owe you, Jace Beleren. I will try.

events.summary: Tamiyo begins reading her scroll and Jace fastens a glyph on the moon to Emrakul.
events.quote: A glyph flashed onto the moon

events.summary: Nissa collapses having drained the leylines, and the spell is about to fail.
events.quote: It was not going to be enough.

events.summary: Tamiyo, cut off from Jace's mind, reads a second iron-banded scroll, and a flood of mana pours into the spell.
events.quote: Tamiyo pulled out another scroll, a long scroll, a scroll with iron bands

events.summary: A silver beam from the moon stretches Emrakul toward it until she snaps, folds and collapses to nothing, bound in the moon.
events.quote: Emrakul was gone. They had won.

events.summary: Liliana, having survived, stares at the moon and curses Emrakul to rot there forever.
events.quote: May you rot there forever.

events.summary: Liliana resolves to treat powerful friends as better zombies and dreams of her own Gatewatch.
events.quote: My very own Gatewatch.

events.summary: Gideon asks Tamiyo to join the Gatewatch and she excuses herself.
events.quote: Tamiyo shook her head, excusing herself

events.summary: Liliana swears the Gatewatch oath to Gideon with calculated sincerity and becomes a member.
events.quote: I see that together we're more powerful than we are alone.

events.summary: Liliana is now a member of the Gatewatch and sees futures full of promise and ambition.
events.quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch.

events.summary: Tamiyo tearfully tells Jace that Emrakul took over her body to read the second scroll.
events.quote: It...she...took me over.

events.summary: Tamiyo reveals the scroll cast a changed spell that trapped Emrakul herself, leaving them unsure what they did.
events.quote: instead it fueled a spell that trapped herself here

events.summary: Tamiyo asks if they really won and flies off into the dark sky with no parting words.
events.quote: Eventually she rose and flew into the dark sky.

events.summary: Jace, alone, recalls the angel's words that it is not her time yet and goes to find a bed.
events.quote: It is not my time. Not yet.

relations.note: She swears the oath and joins, planning to use the group.
relations.quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch.

relations.note: A voice speaking directly in her head, urging her to flee.
relations.quote: Not her thoughts, but the Raven Man speaking directly in her head, sounding...scared.

relations.note: She wields it and draws on its power despite the pain.
relations.quote: Without conscious thought she drew deep on the power of the Chain Veil
When her brother Josu's eyes had opened lifelessly, jet-black orbs portending doom

relations.note: She killed the demon lords Kothophed and Griselbrand.
relations.quote: When she killed the demon lords Kothophed and Griselbrand, hearing their death screams.

relations.note: She killed the demon lords Kothophed and Griselbrand.
relations.quote: When she killed the demon lords Kothophed and Griselbrand, hearing their death screams.

relations.note: She once thought to exploit the feelings he had for her.
relations.quote: Once upon a time recently she had thought to leverage the emotions Jace had for her.

relations.note: They have touched minds and Jace knows her essence well.
relations.quote: Jace had touched Tamiyo mind to mind, knew the essence of her better than most.

relations.note: Nissa feels she owes Jace for rescuing her mind.
relations.quote: But I owe you, Jace Beleren.

relations.note: In the vision Erebos torments Gideon, who says everything from him is poison.
relations.quote: You cannot defeat me, mortal. You never have. You never will.

relations.note: Jace made the copy as a contingency plan to stay separate from himself.
relations.quote: So I made a contingency plan to keep me separate from me

relations.note: Jace concludes the angel is his mind's personification of Emrakul's emanations.
relations.quote: This was his mind's attempt to make sense of whatever pressures or emanations he was feeling from Emrakul.

relations.note: After the binding, Emrakul is sealed in the moon's depths.
relations.quote: In that moon's depths was the most powerful and destructive force any of them had ever encountered.
